title: picris asplenioides subsp. saharae
intro: Picris asplenioides subsp. saharae, commonly known as Sahara Picris, is a subspecies of the Picris asplenioides plant, a type of thistle-like flowering plant. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Picris asplenioides subsp. saharae include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
